brief_zh: 岬角上的收分灯塔；盘旋阶梯及低码头。 在灯塔发出警报前夺取它；低处码头更安全但绕路。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Slate-roofed warehouses, narrow alleys, working quay and fishing homes. Fight through warehouse alleys or cross the exposed quay; protect civilian cargo from incidental damage. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 石板屋顶货仓、窄巷、工作码头与渔民住屋。 穿过仓库巷道或突击暴露码头；避免误毁民用货物。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Two low chart houses on tidal islets with a partly flooded causeway. Secure two chart huts linked by a tidal causeway; choose a landing while the tide changes. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 潮汐小岛上的两间海图房与半淹堤道。 夺取潮汐堤道连接的两处海图房；随潮位选择登陆点。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Paired massive towers with an iron chain over a channel, a separate winch yard. Break the two chain towers; occupy the winch after suppressing the defending formation. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 海峡双巨塔、横水铁链与独立绞盘院。 攻破双锁链塔，压制守军后控制绞盘。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Timber ribs of ships, dry dock, slipways and ropewalk. Disable launch ramps and seize the dry dock before a relief ship departs. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 木质船肋、干船坞、下水滑道与制绳长廊。 阻止援船离港，控制滑道和船坞。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Weathered royal stone heads emerging above the tide; readable pedestal inscriptions. Inspect the monument inscriptions; choose one of two relic caches instead of a compulsory battle. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 潮水上露出的先王巨像，基座保留可辨铭文。 调查巨像铭文，在两处遗物中选择其一，无强制战斗。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Low harbour bastion and protected mooring field; open water for patrol craft. Capture the harbour fort while patrol boats threaten the landing zone. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 低矮港堡、受保护的泊位区与巡逻船活动水面。 在巡逻船威胁登陆区时攻下锚地堡垒。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Oil shops, warm windows and narrow channels between occupied cottages. Secure the pilot pier without destroying occupied homes; shallow channels limit large formations. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 灯油铺、暖窗与住人小屋之间的狭窄水道。 夺取引航码头并保护民居；浅水通道限制大型阵形。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Silted harbour basin, unused cranes, former stone customs hall. Inspect the silted basin and interview harbour workers; choose repair advice or a supply cache. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 淤积港池、废置吊架与旧石砌海关厅。 勘察淤积港池并询问工人；选择修港建议或补给储藏。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Watermill beside a working bridge and a clear upstream channel. Control the mill bridge before reinforcements cross; keep the mill intact if possible. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 磨桥相邻的水磨与清楚的上游河道。 在援兵过桥前控制磨桥，尽量保全磨坊。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Ordinary farm cottages, ration post and civilian grain barn separated visually. Break the levy garrison by taking its ration station; avoid the civilian granary. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 普通农舍、配粮站与民用粮仓视觉分离。 夺取配粮站瓦解征发守军，避开民用粮仓。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Tiered stone warehouses with three defensible entrances, ventilated dry stores. Seize three warehouse gates; suppress the garrison without burning the food stores. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 阶梯式石粮仓、三个可防御入口及通风干燥仓储。 夺取三处仓门，压制守军而不焚毁粮储。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Sluice gates and dual banks with ferry and bridge landings. Control both banks and operate the sluice; bridge and ferry provide distinct approaches. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 水闸与两岸，渡船登陆和桥路并存。 控制两岸并操作水闸；桥路与渡船为不同进路。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Low burial stones revealed by tide, weathered ferryman token, no monsters required. Read the burial stones at low tide; choose a safe ferry route or a relic cache. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 落潮露出的低葬碑与风化渡魂信物，无需怪物。 落潮时辨读葬碑，选择安全渡线或遗物。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Flooded lower hall, elevated reading ledges, shelves above the water line. Navigate the flooded lower hall; choose to copy the founding charter or inspect Oswin’s notes, with both readable if safe. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 积水下厅、高处阅览台与水线上方书架。 穿过积水下厅；优先抄录盟约或查看奥斯温批注，安全时可兼取。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Abandoned royal ferry stairs and weathered memorial rooms, pre-Day masonry. Survey the old ferry stairs and memorial rooms; recover a dynastic relic. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 废弃王家渡阶、风化纪念室及永昼前石构。 勘察古渡阶梯与纪念室，回收王朝遗物。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Country house garden, shallow irrigation ditch and fruit trees; no battlefield clutter. Visit the damaged country house; recover a childhood sketch, with no garrison encounter required. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 庄园花园、浅引水沟与果树；无战场杂物。 探访破损庄园，找到童年速写，不要求战斗。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Unmarked graves among tidal stones; hidden inscribed slabs beneath paths. Read concealed names before the tide rises; a witness may volunteer to speak. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 潮间石地的无名墓，路下隐藏刻名石板。 涨潮前辨读隐藏姓名；证人可自愿作证。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Bell tower, cloister, archive room and visible holy-field footprint. Silence the bell tower’s holy field, then seize the record room. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 钟塔、回廊、档案室及清晰圣光作用区域。 压制钟楼圣光区域，再夺取档案室。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Ceremonial stone jetty and sombre covered cargo shelters. Secure the ceremonial jetty and stop the transfer without destroying the records. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 仪式石码头与肃穆的遮蔽货棚。 控制仪式码头，阻止转运且不毁记录。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: White-stone customs quay, merchant seals and civic guard post. Secure the customs quay and negotiate a passage with merchants after the local guard yields. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 白石海关码头、商人印记与市政守卫岗。 控制海关码头，守卫投降后与商人协商通行。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Naval gate with heavy portcullis and white-gold military insignia. Open the naval gate through military pressure or recognition of the lawful ruler. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 重闸军港门、白金军事标志。 以军事压力或承认合法君主打开军港门。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Broad grain landing with cranes, inspection tables and supply records. Secure the grain landing and obtain a statement of available stocks. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 宽阔粮运登陆场、吊架、查验台与粮册。 控制粮运登陆点，取得可用粮储清单。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Quiet processional steps, covered landing and documented access threshold. Follow the ceremonial waterway, secure its landing and obtain current access papers. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 安静仪式阶梯、遮蔽登陆区及文书查验入口。 沿仪式水道控制登陆点，取得本轮通行文书。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: White stone terraces: audience hall, council chamber, muster court, winter council and hidden Seal beneath; separate scene layers. Audience, Council confrontation, Muster, Winter Council, Seal, epilogue; choices are separated. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 白石阶城：会面厅、议会厅、集结庭、冬政会议及地下秘印，分层制作。 王室会面、摄政对质、军团集结、冬政会议、秘印、尾声；选择分开作出。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Cold outer harbour, empty relief store, waiting families at the waterfront. Seize the outer harbour and inspect the empty relief store; spare the waiting families. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 寒冷外港、空赈粮仓、岸边等待的家属。 攻占外港并检查空赈粮仓，保护等待救济的家庭。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Isolated rock watchtower, exposed landing and signal platform. Land below the watch tower and disable the alert before a patrol reaches the northern passage. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 孤立礁石岗哨塔、暴露登陆点与信号台。 从岗哨塔下登陆，在巡逻队抵达北峡前切断警报。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Salt sheds and drying pans, tollhouse, sheltered merchant docks. Secure the tollhouse; choose to preserve the salt depots rather than seize everything as spoils. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 盐棚、晒盐池、税关与避风商码头。 控制税关；可保全盐仓而非悉数掠夺。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Furnace courtyards, blast gates and separate armour stores, readable hazard zones. Cross exposed furnace yards, shut the blast gates and capture the armour depot. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 炉场庭院、炉门与独立甲具仓，危险区清晰。 横穿暴露炉场，关闭炉门并控制甲具库。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Old memorial field with ruined standards, stone terraces and competing inscriptions. Search the old memorial field and compare royal and surrendered soldiers’ accounts. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 古战场纪念地、残旗、石台及相互矛盾的铭文。 探索古战场纪念地，对照王室与投降士兵记录。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Toll ferry, ledger office, narrow river banks and modest market stalls. Control the toll ferry and ledger office; defending formations use narrow river approaches. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 税渡、账房、狭窄河岸与小市场摊。 控制税渡与账房；守军依托狭窄河道。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Regional civic hall with a petition archive, covered market and central courtyard. Capture the civic courtyard and protect the petition archive from destruction. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 地方行政厅、请愿档案室、遮棚市场及中心庭院。 控制行政庭院并保护请愿档案。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Reed-lined shallows, low ferry and raised embankment with limited heavy access. Secure a reed-lined crossing; use shallow approaches while heavy defenders hold the embankment. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 芦苇浅滩、低渡口及限制重装通行的高堤。 控制芦苇渡口；重装守军守堤时利用浅水路线。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Quiet care courtyard, register desk, beds screened from the approach. Speak to caretakers and inspect registers; let residents remain undisturbed. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 安静照护院落、名册台与避开进路的病床。 与照护者交谈并检查名册，不打扰住民。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Ice-filled court halls, abandoned harbour visible below, no compulsory garrison. Survey frozen halls and recover the winter accounts; no compulsory boss. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 冰封宫厅与下方废港可见，无强制驻军。 勘察冰封宫厅并找到寒冬账册，不强制首领战。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Ancient stone bridge with central arch collapsed and usable ferry bypass. Secure the bridgehead ferry and collapsed span; boats bypass the broken central arch. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 古石桥中央拱坍塌，保留可用渡船绕行。 控制桥头渡船与断桥；用船绕过坍塌中拱。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Sealed stone warehouses, guarded record office and a ritual barge. Capture the sealed warehouse before the cargo register is removed; secure the ritual barge. Use regional kit; concept or blockout only as needed.
brief_zh: 封印石仓、受守卫的记录室与仪式驳船。 在货册被转移前夺取封印仓库，控制仪式驳船。 复用地区组件；按需概念图或灰盒。

brief_en: Flagship sinking into dark water; no victorious court. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 旗舰沉入暗水，不出现获胜宫廷。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。

brief_en: Undead king in bright court, bound guard still in formation. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 永昼宫廷中的亡灵国王，受束缚卫队仍列队。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。

brief_en: Edmund crowned, former company departing, daylight remains. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 埃德蒙加冕，旧部离去，永昼仍在。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。

brief_en: Living queen on throne, undead commander beside it, bound troops in background. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 活人女王在位，亡灵统帅在旁，背景受军誓约束的军队。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。

brief_en: Eleanor’s court and freed company boarding ordinary boats; sun remains. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 妹妹宫廷与登船离去的自由旧部，太阳仍在。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。

brief_en: Edmund crowned, compelled company aiding the harbour after sunset. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 王子在位，日落后受命军团帮助港口。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。

brief_en: Undead king signs winter budget by candlelight, no compelled ranks. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 亡灵国王烛下签冬季预算，无强制列队。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。

brief_en: Queen and undead brother on shore after sunset, army still bound. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 日落后女王与亡灵兄长岸边相会，军誓仍在。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。

brief_en: Siblings witness fading light on white walls, released crew. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 兄妹看白墙光彩消退，旧部获自由。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。

brief_en: Ferryman and Edmund embark into the Grey Sea; no return shore, fade to credits. Read the matching A.5 epilogue. Reuse approved compositions and state variants; no printed narration.
brief_zh: 渡魂人与埃德蒙驶向灰海；无回归岸，淡出进入演职员表。 阅读对应A.5尾声，复用获批构图和状态变体，不印旁白。
